faq.question: Is QuizIn free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. QuizIn is free — create a room, invite friends with a 6-letter code, and start playing. No account or download is required.

faq.question: How many players can join a quiz room?
faq.answer: Friends join the same room with your room code and display name. The host starts the game when everyone is ready.

faq.question: What quiz modes are available?
faq.answer: Classic Quiz is multiple-choice trivia with a shared timer. Geography Quiz shows a country name — players click the country on an interactive world map. The host picks the mode in the waiting room.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer: No. QuizIn runs in your browser. For local development the game server must be running; in production the site connects automatically.

faq.question: How does scoring work?
faq.answer: In classic mode, faster correct answers earn more points. Geography mode rewards whoever finds the country on the map first. After the last question you see a leaderboard and review.

multiplayer-quiz.title: Multiplayer Quiz Online with Friends
multiplayer-quiz.headline: Real-time multiplayer quiz rooms
multiplayer-quiz.description: Host a free online quiz for friends. Create a room, share your code, and play classic trivia or geography together in the browser.
bullets: 6-letter room codes — easy to share in chat or on a call
Live scores and leaderboards after each game
Classic trivia and geography map modes
Works on desktop and mobile browsers

howItWorks.title: Create a room
howItWorks.body: Enter your name and tap Create room. You become the host.

howItWorks.title: Invite friends
howItWorks.body: Share the room code. Friends join with the same code and their names.

howItWorks.title: Pick a mode & start
howItWorks.body: The host chooses Classic or Geography, adjusts settings, and starts the quiz.

classic-quiz.title: Classic Trivia Quiz — Multiplayer
classic-quiz.headline: Multiple-choice trivia with friends
classic-quiz.description: Play a fast-paced classic quiz online. Everyone gets the same questions, races the timer, and competes for the top spot on the leaderboard.
bullets: Shared questions for every player in the room
Configurable timer and number of questions
Answer review at the end of the game

howItWorks.title: Join or host
howItWorks.body: Open the quiz room, create a game, or join with a friend's code.

howItWorks.title: Select Classic Quiz
howItWorks.body: The host sets Classic mode and options like question count and time limit.

howItWorks.title: Answer before time runs out
howItWorks.body: Pick the right option quickly — faster correct answers score higher.

geography-quiz.title: Geography Quiz — World Map Game
geography-quiz.headline: Click countries on the world map
geography-quiz.description: Free online geography quiz: a country name appears — be the first to find it on the interactive world map. Perfect for map lovers and classroom fun.
bullets: Interactive world map powered by d3-geo
Country-name prompts — click the matching territory
Zoom and pan to explore the map while you play

howItWorks.title: Start a geography room
howItWorks.body: Create a room and choose Geography Quiz in the lobby (or use the button below).

howItWorks.title: Read the country
howItWorks.body: Each round shows a country name. Find it on the map before others do.

howItWorks.title: Win the round
howItWorks.body: First correct click scores the point. Play through all countries and check the final standings.
